# Before Slack

*Kor went through the gap before slack and had to put in on the Undercliff, where the Shore Crabs went for his boat. Clear 50 of them from the Undercliff.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 50 [Shore Crab](../monsters/shore_crab.md) in [The Undercliff](../maps/undercliff.md)

- 5,700 EXP
- 1,200 mesos
- [Fish Cake](../items/fish_cake.md) x10

- +150 standing with [Kor](../npcs/warden_kor.md)
